summary: Bilibili Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 28, 2026, announcing that its board of directors will hold a meeting on May 19, 2026 (Hong Kong Time) to approve and publish its unaudited first-quarter 2026 earnings results. The filing also details the earnings conference call and webcast logistics. This is a routine earnings announcement and board meeting notice, not a special situation. No deal terms, price, premium, or advisory roles are mentioned.
